name: mixed
why: The realistic case. Both surfaces present at once, so the skill has to keep the two colours distinct rather than flattening everything into one severity.
seed: Two things this session. First, we agreed that retries should use exponential backoff capped at 30 seconds, and that the cap belongs in config rather than hardcoded — that rationale has not been written down anywhere. Second, I edited src/retry.ts with the cap constant and created a new src/circuit-breaker.ts. Neither file is committed.

items.about: the exponential-backoff-capped-at-30s rationale and the config-not-hardcoded reasoning, never written down
